title: The Resolved Star Formation Law in NGC 7469 from JWST, ALMA, and VLA
question: Investigate the spatially resolved star formation process and correlations between PAHs, star formation rate surface density, and cold molecular gas mass surface density within the central 3.3 kpc region of NGC 7469.

recipe.goal: Image ALMA Band 6 continuum and CO(2-1) data cube and generate Moment 0 map
recipe.method: Average visibilities across 4 spectral windows excluding CO(2-1) line to image 1.3 mm continuum; subtract 1st-order polynomial from CO(2-1) spw visibilities and image cube with tclean; integrate in velocity to produce CO(2-1) moment-0 map blanked below 1 sigma.
key_parameters: deconvolver = hogbom, threshold = 3 rms, Briggs robust b = 0.5 (continuum), natural weighting (CO(2-1) cube), channel width = 5 km s^-1

recipe.goal: Model and subtract central AGN point source from VLA 22 GHz visibilities and image continuum
recipe.method: Average 62 spws of calibrated VLA K-band visibilities; model a central point source at the AGN position with flux 5.037 mJy (90% of central beam flux), subtract it from visibilities using uvsub, and clean with tclean.
key_parameters: AGN position = 23:03:15.617 +08:52:26.00 J2000, point source flux = 5.037 mJy (90% of central beam flux), circumnuclear flux correction = 15%, Briggs robust b = 0.5, hogbom, threshold = 3 rms
assumptions: 90% of the central beam flux at 22 GHz is due to the central AGN point source.

recipe.goal: Model and subtract radial PSF contribution from JWST/MIRI F770W map
recipe.method: Simulate the JWST/MIRI F770W PSF using WebbPSF (pixel size 0.027 arcsec), model the radial PSF contribution in circular sectors with radius equal to the grid cell size (1 arcsec), and apply radial correction to extracted F770W fluxes and errors.
key_parameters: Simulated PSF pixel size = 0.027 arcsec, circular sector radius = 1 arcsec, central 1 arcsec (~330 pc) excluded
assumptions: 90% of the F770W filter flux is attributed to the 7.7 um PAH feature (10% hot dust continuum contamination).

recipe.goal: Regrid maps to common resolution, extract grid fluxes, and compute physical surface densities (Sigma_H2, Sigma_SFR, SB_PAH)
recipe.method: Regrid ALMA CO(2-1), VLA 22 GHz, and JWST F770W maps to the VLA spatial resolution; apply a 10 arcsec x 10 arcsec grid of 1 arcsec x 1 arcsec (0.330 kpc) cells centered on the AGN; exclude the central AGN cell and cells with mean flux < 3 rms/pixel; convert extracted fluxes to Sigma_H2 (Eq. 1), Sigma_SFR (via 1.4 GHz extrapolation and Shao et al. 2018), and SB_PAH, plus integrated M(H2), SFR, and depletion time tau_dep = M(H2)/SFR.
key_parameters: Grid size = 10 arcsec x 10 arcsec (3.3 kpc x 3.3 kpc), cell size = 1 arcsec x 1 arcsec (0.330 kpc), detection threshold = 3 rms per pixel, number of valid data points = 82 (31 at r < r_SB, 51 at r > r_SB)
assumptions: D_L = 72.1 Mpc (0.338 kpc/arcsec); inclination i = 45 deg; R_21 = 0.7; alpha_CO = 4.2 (+1.961/-1.341) M_sun (K km s^-1 pc^2)^-1 for log(M_*/M_sun) = 10.5; radio spectral index alpha = -0.85 between 1.4 and 22 GHz; 90% of F770W flux from PAH.

recipe.goal: Quantify correlations and fit linear scaling relations between SB_PAH, Sigma_SFR, and Sigma_H2
recipe.method: Compute Pearson rho and Kendall tau rank correlation coefficients; fit linear relations y = n x + k in log-log space using MCMC (emcee) for the full sample (r > 0), inner SB ring (r < r_SB = 900 pc), and outer region (r > r_SB) for SB_PAH vs Sigma_SFR, SB_PAH vs Sigma_H2, and the Kennicutt-Schmidt law (log Sigma_SFR vs log Sigma_H2).
key_parameters: r_SB = 900 pc; N = 82 total points (31 for r < r_SB, 51 for r > r_SB)
assumptions: Constant error on Sigma_H2 and Sigma_SFR equal to the rms noise of each regridded map; error on SB_PAH obtained by convolving rms noise of regridded MIRI map with PSF uncertainty.

score_reason: All three datasets (ALMA, VLA, JWST) are publicly available in archives with explicit project codes/DOIs, software versions (CASA 5.1.1-5, WebbPSF 1.2.1) and main tclean parameters (hogbom, robust=0.5/natural, 3rms threshold) as well as physical conversion formulas and assumptions are clearly stated; however, minor imaging parameters (pixel/image sizes, velocity integration windows), PSF-matching details prior to regridding, and the exact units of SB_PAH in Table 1/Figure 3 are omitted.
rediscovery_reason: All raw/calibrated data are public in the ALMA, VLA, and MAST archives, the data reduction and 1-arcsec grid analysis recipe are straightforward, and the paper reports clear numeric benchmarks (rms noises, global SFR and M(H2), depletion timescales, and MCMC correlation slopes).
